summary.text: Jehan Gordon-Booth is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 92nd District, based in Peoria.

paragraphs.text: According to the Illinois House Democrats biography, Gordon-Booth holds a B.A. from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, is a former local school board member and a former Illinois Central College staff member, and was a 2013 Edgar Fellow.
The biography says Gordon-Booth lives in Peoria.
